description: Embed a LIVE mosadd chat channel into an app/site you're building (great for builder-agents on Lovable/Bolt/Cursor/v0). Mints a publishable embed key scoped to a channel + the app's domain(s) and returns a ready-to-paste HTML snippet (a <div> + <script src=embed.mosadd.com/v1.js data-key=…>). Visitors of the host page chat in real time (anonymous nick or mosadd login). REQUIRES `allowed_origins` — the domain(s) the app is served from (the key only works there). The publishable key is browser-safe (mints only channel-scoped JWTs); your hub key never leaves the server. Returns { embed_key, channel, allowed_origins, snippet }.

allowed_origins.description: REQUIRED. Domain(s) where the widget will be served — the key only works from these origins. Use the host(s) of the app you're building, e.g. ['app.acme.com','*.acme.com']. For local testing use mode:'test' and e.g. 'localhost:3000'.

anon.description: Allow visitors to join with just a nick (no mosadd account). Default true.

channel.description: The mIRC channel id everyone on the embed shares (e.g. 'acme-support'). Auto-created on first message if new.

mode.description: Key mode — 'test' for local/dev origins, 'live' for production. Default 'live'.

name.description: Label for the key in the owner's dashboard. Default 'embed: <channel>'.

title.description: Header title shown in the widget. Default 'mIRC'.

name: comms_embed_create
